trial_court: Family Court Imphal East at Lamphelpat (Mat. (Div.) Suit No. 72 of 2025)
case_name: Telen Kom vs Date: 2025.12 on 1 December, 2025
facts_of_case: Husband and wife filed a petition seeking divorce by mutual consent under 'Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955'; impugned order allowed the petition; wife filed a civil revision petition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking revision to establish that the impugned order is contrary to law or grossly erroneous.
legal_principles.held: Without issuing notice to the respondents, this Court deems it appropriate to requisition a report along with entire records from the said Family Court as regards whether the revision petitioner (Tongbram Ongbi Rashirani Devi) deposed before the learned District Judge and the supporting records in this regard.

legal_principles.principle: A report shall be sent by the learned Judicial Officer of said Family Court to the Registrar (Judl.) of this Court in a sealed envelope who in turn shall place the sealed envelope before this Court.

outcome.final_order: Court deems it appropriate to requisition a report along with entire records from the said Family Court as regards whether the revision petitioner (wife) deposed before the learned District Judge and the supporting records in this regard.
